text:
Alice M.: Quick pre-oncall check — I'm up in ~30m. Can folks confirm VPN, pager registration, runbook access, and that they can reach the nonprod jump host? Leaving a short checklist here so we don't scramble.

Ben R.: I'll start — VPN + ok for me, still need to confirm pager enrollment for the new rotation.

Carmen G.: @Ben R. remind me which group to add you to? Is it 'oncall-frontend' or 'oncall-runtime'?

Ben R.: runtime please.

Carmen G.: got it. Also note MFA was flaky yesterday for a couple people — if you hit a 2FA loop, DM me.

DevOps Bot: PagerDuty sync: user Ben R. queued for group oncall-runtime at 2026-03-18T03:00Z — pending acceptance.

Priya S.: Runbook access: link is https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall-runtime — you need the 'runtime-oncall' group to view. If you can't access, add a screenshot and I'll escalate.

Alice M.: Good. Two quick manual checks everyone should run now:
1) VPN connect + curl healthcheck on nonprod jump
2) Verify secret retrieval from Vault path
3) Trigger a synthetic alert to ensure pager routes

Alice M.: VPN test (example):
```
# connect (company VPN client) then on jump host
curl -sS https://jump.nonprod.redwood.ai/health || echo 'jump unreachable'
```

Ben R.: curl returns 'ok' for me. Jump SSH also works.

Carmen G.: Vault check: `vault kv get -format=json secret/oncall/runtime` — make sure `api_key` is present and `last_rotated` < 90d.

Priya S.: I ran the vault command, key present but last_rotated = 120d. We should rotate before tomorrow's rotation window. Flagging to infra.

Carmen G.: Yikes. @Infra (cc infra channel) — recommend emergency rotate for that secret or create a scoped oncall key. I'll open a ticket.

DevOps Bot: Incident ticket created #INC-4821 by Carmen G. — subject "Rotate runtime oncall vault key".

Alice M.: For pager test (non-prod): trigger synthetic alert with the runbook script:
```
# run from ci-tools
python tools/synthetic_alert.py --service runtime --env nonprod --test-route oncall-runtime
```
It should create an alert and PagerDuty will send to the group.

Ben R.: Triggered test — I got the push on my phone, accepted. :thumbsup: Pager route looks healthy.

Priya S.: Confirmed I got a webhook event in AppLogs, id=evt_20260318_77a3.

Carmen G.: MFA check: if you get stuck with SSO loop, try clearing SSO cookies and re-initiate from https://sso.redwood.ai/login — had one engineer fixed by this earlier.

Alice M.: Thanks. Last small thing: ensure Slack runbook pinned messages are visible: open the runbook page and verify the pinned play 'restart runtime pool' is present. If not, DM me and I'll paste the snippet.

Ben R.: I see the pinned play and the quick restart command. All green on my side except Priya's vault rotation flag.

Priya S.: I'll follow up on the ticket and coordinate rotation; will update this thread when done.

Alice M.: Awesome — ready to take handoff in 25m. If anyone else is joining, please confirm here.

Carmen G.: I'm on standby and reachable.

DevOps Bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff at 2026-03-18T03:00Z — please accept the calendar invite.

Priya S.: Ticket INC-4821 assigned to infra-team, ETA 6h for rotation. I'll add a mitigation note to the runbook (temp scoped key).

Alice M.: Noted. Thanks everyone — see you on shift.

Ben R.: Oncall accepted.

Carmen G.: Accepted.

Priya S.: Will post update when rotation is complete.

Alice M.: :rocket:
